sequoia-pennylane:lever:137b7257-ad17-4d.title: Senior HR Business Partner (m/w/d)
sequoia-pennylane:lever:137b7257-ad17-4d.descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

Über uns
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).
In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:
💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.
💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.
🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.
🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.
🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Um unser weiteres Wachstum zu unterstützen, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n HR Business Partner:in zur Verstärkung unseres People-Teams.

In dieser Rolle berichtest Du direkt an unsere Lead HR Business Partnerin und den Country Manager Deutschland Tobias Janiesch. Du arbeitest sowohl operativ als auch strategisch. Du bist eine vertrauensvolle Sparringspartner:in für unsere Teams und übernimmst gleichzeitig die Rolle einer Programmmanager:in, um eine erstklassige Employee Experience zu gestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Du agierst als Partner:in innerhalb des People-Teams. Dank Deiner ausgeprägten Entscheidungsstärke und Deines tiefen Verständnisses für Talent Management und Organisationsdesign in Technologieunternehmen unterstützt Du unsere Teams in einer Phase starken Wachstums. Dabei bist Du verantwortlich für die Umsetzung und Begleitung aller Projekte und Aufgaben, die gemeinsam mit der HR Development Managerin entwickelt werden.

Deine Aufgaben

HR Business Partnering
- Du etablierst regelmäßige Rituale mit Führungskräften und Teammitgliedern, um vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen und erste Ansprechperson für die Teams zu werden.
- Mit einem tiefen Verständnis für Deine betreuten Zielgruppen begleitest Du Teams entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles (Onboarding, 3- und 6-Monats-Feedback, Performance Reviews, Gehaltsrunden, interne Wechsel, Offboarding etc.).
- Du berätst Führungskräfte zu Organisationsdesign, individueller Performance, Beförderungen und Vergütung.
- Du unterstützt Mitarbeitende bei Themen wie Learning & Development, Karrierepfade und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
- Du fungierst als Schnittstelle für interne Kommunikation in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich, stellst die Einhaltung bestehender Richtlinien sicher und bringst neue HR-Prozesse sowie unsere Unternehmenskultur aktiv in die Organisation, um die Mitarbeiterbindung zu stärken.

Talent Development
- Du arbeitest aktiv an Projekten entlang der Roadmap des People-Teams mit.
- Du entwickelst und verantwortest fundierte Datenanalysen und Reportings, abgestimmt auf Business-Bedürfnisse, um die Wirksamkeit von Programmen und Prozessen messbar zu machen.

Das Profil, das wir suchen
- Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit – Erfahrung in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen ist ein großes Plus.
- Du hast breite HR-Erfahrung, u. a. in den Bereichen Onboarding, Learning & Development, Arbeitsrecht sowie Compensation & Benefits.
- Du bist exzellent darin, Vertrauen aufzubauen und tragfähige Arbeitsbeziehungen auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zu entwickeln.
- Du verfügst über sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch und Englisch.
- Du hast Erfahrung darin, Performance-Management in stark wachsenden Organisationen zu steuern (300+ Neueinstellungen pro Jahr).
- Du kannst interne Stakeholder souverän durch Projekte begleiten, z. B. bei Organisationsdesigns oder der Antizipation zukünftiger Bedarfe und Herausforderungen.

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, solltest Du
- Energie aus einem sich ständig verändernden Arbeitsumfeld ziehen
- Sehr kollaborativ arbeiten – sowohl im eigenen Team als auch mit anderen Stakeholdern
- Genug Erfahrung mitbringen, um im Alltag business-relevante Prioritäten zu setzen
- Uns ist bewusst, dass sich manche Menschen nur bewerben, wenn sie alle Anforderungen erfüllen.
Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen
🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.
🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.
📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.
🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.
🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.
💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.
🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

Wen wir suchen
Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:
- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).
- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.
- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).
- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

serena-malt:lever:7a628415-8db7-41c1-bf1.title: Key Account Manager - Global Accounts - BENELUX
serena-malt:lever:7a628415-8db7-41c1-bf1.descriptionHtml:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 850,000 talented freelancers with 90,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
  • A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
  • A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
  • Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
  • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Explore your future career  🔭
 
As our new Key Account Manager for Global Accounts - with the internal title National Account Manager - you will ensure the local deployment, adoption, and growth of global enterprise accounts within the BENELUX region. You will join the Global Account Management team, acting as a key local partner to activate use cases, support first projects, and resolve operational issues.
Your mission is to provide country-specific insights that help scale our largest multinational accounts internationally.
  • Ownership & Strategy: Take ownership of your global enterprise accounts within the BENELUX region. You will design and drive local account strategies while acting as a strategic counterpart to the Global Account Manager (GAM) at the client's HQ, ensuring local execution perfectly aligns with global objectives.
  • Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture trust-based relationships with key local decision-makers across HR, Procurement, and Business Units. You are the driving force behind local platform adoption and account penetration.
  • Deployment & Pilot Leadership: Lead the successful local integration of global framework agreements. You orchestrate pilot programs and initial projects from the ground up to ensure a seamless rollout and immediate value realization.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the central hub for your accounts by working closely with internal stakeholders. You will collaborate seamlessly with Marketing, Finance, Customer Success & Onboarding, and the Delivery Team to ensure a holistic, top-tier client experience and align all efforts toward account growth.
  • Global Synergy & Best Practice Sharing: Work hand-in-hand with an international network of Key Account Managers managing your accounts across different markets. You will actively share best practices, align on overarching strategies, and ensure a cohesive, unified approach that goes far beyond just a local scope.
  • Proactive Expansion & Farming: Go beyond the status quo by running targeted local prospection. You will map out new departments and teams, uncovering and converting new growth opportunities within your existing accounts.
  • Consultative Needs Assessment: Dive deep into the specific pains and needs of your local stakeholders using the MEDDIC framework. You translate these insights into tailored solutions while maintaining impeccable, data-driven CRM hygiene.
  • Value Demonstration & ROI: Lead local Business Reviews and deliver compelling, ROI-focused presentations to C-level executives. You will highlight local successes and coordinate with the GAM to showcase our holistic, multinational value.
  • Operational Excellence & Partnerships: Act as the primary point of contact for local Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and vendor networks. You proactively resolve operational roadblocks, monitor delivery performance, and ensure a flawless customer experience.
  • AI-Driven Sales Enablement: Leverage cutting-edge AI tools in your daily workflows to maximize efficiency and strategic output. You will collaborate directly with our internal AI Champions and utilize our established AI sales enablement solutions to enhance account planning, outreach, and data analysis.
  • Enterprise Experience: You have a proven track record in Strategic Account Management or Enterprise Sales, ideally with experience managing complex, major accounts.
  • Strategic Vision: You possess the ability to transform a high-level framework agreement into a detailed, long-term strategic plan that perfectly aligns with your client's business objectives.
  • Commercial Acumen: You have a deep understanding of contract profitability and a talent for articulating ROI and the value delivered at every stage of the customer journey.
  • Hunter-Farmer Mindset: You bring a proactive mindset for "farming" within large organizations; you genuinely enjoy hunting for new expansion opportunities and mapping out new departments within an existing account.
  • Executive Communication: You have exceptional skills in crafting and delivering strategic, ROI-focused presentations that resonate with C-level executives and key decision-makers.
  • Sales Excellence & Data Discipline: You show strong discipline in MEDDIC fundamentals and maintain a data-driven approach to CRM management, ensuring predictable forecasting.
  • Project Management Skills: You have the ability to structure complex deployments into clear, manageable projects with precise milestones and deadlines.
  • Languages: You have full professional proficiency in both English and French. Good proficiency in Dutch is a plus.
  • Mobility: You bring a willingness to travel regularly within your home country (at least once a month) to build strong, in-person relationships if you are not co-located with your clients.
  • First call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes)
  • Interview with your future manager, Karim, to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (45-60 minutes)
  • Business case in order to assess your technical skills in account development and local prospection.
  • Reference Check 
  • Final interview with a C-level executive to discuss Malt’s long-term vision and how you fit into our strategic growth.(30-45 minutes)
  • Brussels office visit: Coffee chat with the team. (30 minutes)
    • Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.
    💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.
    📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years.
    📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options.
    🚇 Transportation: Every Malter is entitled to a mobility budget.
    🍴 Lunch vouchers: Monizze, 8€/day.
    🏡 Home office allowance: 160€ for home office and internet.
    😷 Premium healthcare coverage provided by Axa.
    📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
     
    Your profile may be subject to background screening. For more information see our candidate privacy policy.

somacap-etched:ashbyhq:6f23713f-5409-45b.title: Inference Intern
somacap-etched:ashbyhq:6f23713f-5409-45b.descriptionHtml:
About Etched

Etched is building the world’s first AI inference system purpose-built for transformers - delivering over 10x higher performance and dramatically lower cost and latency than a B200. With Etched ASICs, you can build products that would be impossible with GPUs, like real-time video generation models and extremely deep & parallel chain-of-thought reasoning agents. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

We are seeking talented Fall '26, Spring '27, and Summer '27 Inference Architecture interns to join our team and contribute to the design of next-generation AI accelerators. This role focuses on developing and optimizing compute architectures that deliver exceptional performance and efficiency for transformer workloads. You will work on cutting-edge architectural problems and performance modeling over the course of your internship.

Key responsibilities

  • Support porting state-of-the-art models to our architecture. Help build programming abstractions and testing capabilities to rapidly iterate on model porting.

  • Assist in building, enhancing, and scaling Sohu’s runtime, including multi-node inference, intra-node execution, state management, and robust error handling.

  • Contribute to optimizing routing and communication layers using Sohu’s collectives.

  • Utilize performance profiling and debugging tools to identify bottlenecks and correctness issues.

  • Develop and leverage a deep understanding of Sohu to co-design both HW instructions and model architecture operations to maximize model performance

  • Implement high-performance software components for the Model Toolkit

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Progress towards a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in computer science, computer engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field

  • Proficiency in Python, C++

  • Understanding of performance-sensitive or complex distributed software systems, e.g. Linux internals, accelerator architectures (e.g. GPUs, TPUs), Compilers, or high-speed interconnects (e.g. NVLink, InfiniBand).

  • Ported applications to non-standard accelerator hardware or hardware platforms.

  • Deep knowledge of transformer model architectures and/or inference serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, etc.)

Strong candidates may have some experience with

  • Proficiency in Rust

  • Low-latency, high-performance applications using both kernel-level and user-space networking stacks.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, algorithms, and challenges, including consensus protocols, consistency models, and communication patterns.

  • Solid grasp of Transformer architectures, particularly Mixture-of-Experts (MoE).

  • Built applications with extensive SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) optimizations for performance-critical paths.

  • Familiarity with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Math competitions (AIME, AMC, etc)

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification.

Program details

  • 12-week paid internship

  • Generous housing support for those relocating

  • Daily lunch and dinner in our office

  • Based at our office in San Jose, CA

  • Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers

  • Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time

For any questions, contact internships@etched.com.

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single-model ASICs.

We are a fully in-person team in West San Jose, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

startx-swarm-aero:ashbyhq:4501379d-f13f-.title: PLM Architect (Teamcenter)
startx-swarm-aero:ashbyhq:4501379d-f13f-.descriptionHtml:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

We're looking for a PLM Architect (Teamcenter) to own our product lifecycle management infrastructure and support the Aircraft team day to day. You'll work directly alongside structures and mechanical engineers to ensure our PLM environment is configured, maintained, and scaled to meet the demands of a fast-moving hardware program. This is a hands-on, high-impact role at the center of how we manage design data, change processes, and engineering workflows across the aircraft.

What You'll Do

  • Administer and maintain Siemens Teamcenter environments across development and production, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and patching

  • Partner closely with structures design and mechanical engineers to understand workflow needs and translate them into effective PLM configuration

  • Manage user accounts, roles, groups, access controls, and licensing across the Teamcenter environment

  • Configure and maintain item types, workflows, change management processes, BOM structures, and classification hierarchies

  • Support CAD integrations including NX and other authoring tools used across the aircraft team

  • Troubleshoot and resolve PLM issues quickly, minimizing disruption to active engineering programs

  • Develop and maintain admin documentation, standard operating procedures, and user training materials

  • Collaborate with IT on infrastructure, backup, and disaster recovery for PLM systems

  • Identify and implement continuous improvements to PLM processes as the program scales

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of hands-on Siemens Teamcenter administration experience in a hardware-intensive environment

  • Strong understanding of PLM concepts: BOM management, change/release workflows, document management, and CAD data vaulting

  • Experience supporting mechanical or aerospace engineering teams as a PLM admin or systems engineer

  • Proficiency with Teamcenter server administration on Windows and/or Linux

  • Familiarity with NX or similar CAD integration within Teamcenter

  • Ability to work directly with engineers to diagnose issues and configure solutions without heavy process overhead

  • Strong communication skills and comfort operating in a fast-paced, build-oriented startup environment

  • Aerospace or defense program background is a strong plus, particularly experience with aircraft, UAV, or propulsion development programs

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to MBSE or MBD workflows and associated data management practices

  • Familiarity with Active Workspace configuration and customization

  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, Tcl, or similar) for PLM process automation

  • Experience migrating or consolidating PLM environments

  • Experience building or maintaining a digital thread in a manufacturing environment, connecting design, engineering, and production data across the product lifecycle

Location

This role is hybrid, based out of our headquarters in Oxnard, CA. Candidates must be local to the greater Ventura or Los Angeles County area and able to come onsite regularly and on short notice when the program requires it.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy work environment, Swarm Aero conducts a thorough screening of prospective employees. Candidates will be subject to a comprehensive background verification process as a prerequisite for employment.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

techaviv-walkme:lever:f2ffe20c-6b5c-404a.descriptionHtml:
Industry leader? Well, how about an industry creator?!
 
At WalkMe, now an SAP company, we’re not just the leader in digital adoption, we started the digital adoption revolution - enabling organizations to pinpoint and resolve digital friction, regain control of their tech stack, and be better equipped to manage future change. With over 1,600 clients, including 55 Fortune 100 companies and 6 Fortune 10 companies working with us daily, we’re transforming how enterprises interact with their technology.
 
So, if you’re an expert in your field, and looking for an opportunity to work, collaborate, and innovate with some of the most talented people out there, WalkMe is the place for you!

The VP Alliance & Channels, is responsible for developing and growing WalkMe’s new and existing partner ecosystems across the APAC region, implementing go-to-market strategies, managing relationships with key partners, and driving revenue growth through the partner network. This role involves close collaboration with internal Sales and Marketing teams.

  • Build and expand networks of channel partners, system integrators, and technology alliances across the APAC region

  • Own and deliver partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue targets across APAC

  • Develop strategic partners to use their platform to create opportunities with their customers and achieve revenue targets

  • Manage the approach and go-to-market plan with current and potential partners

  • Team up with Sales to lead account mapping and co-sell opportunities

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to bring awareness and the use of partner integrations that enhance results for WalkMe, partners, and clients

  • Work with our Sales Enablement team to build alliance sales capacity within our Sales team

  • Represent WalkMe at industry events, partner summits, and executive briefings to strengthen brand presence and partner mindshare

  • Minimum 10+  years of Enterprise SaaS Sales and Alliances experience, with a demonstrable track record of building and scaling partner-led revenue

  • 5+ years of regional experience managing a team of Alliance Sales & GTM managers

  • Experience managing relationships with Global Systems Integrators, ISV, and Regional Partners with proven success

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience owning partner revenue targets

  • Deep understanding of the APAC partner landscape and cultural nuances across key markets including SEA and ANZ

  • Knowledge of partner ecosystems and experience establishing relationships that are advantageous for WalkMe

  • Knowledge and experience developing and implementing Partner Programs

  • Knowledge to recognize and grow joint value propositions and use cases

  • Analyze and implement resolutions to problems that align to impacted teams

  • Technical background and contract negotiation experience is desirable

  • Significant focus on revenue generation through partnerships

At WalkMe, we approach Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) with the same level of collaboration, innovation and accountability that we bring to the rest of our business. We believe in the value of diversity and are committed to ensuring an equitable and inclusive workplace where every employee has an equal opportunity to achieve success.
 
WalkMe does not discriminate. If a candidate requires a reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact your Talent Acquisition partner immediately.
 
TO ALL RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: WalkMe does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to WalkMe employees or any other company location. WalkMe is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company for this specific role.

verdane-conductor-inc:rippling:e868975f-.title: Principal Platform Engineer
verdane-conductor-inc:rippling:e868975f-.descriptionHtml:
About Conductor:

Conductor is the leading enterprise AEO platform. Today’s top enterprise brands use Conductor to grow authority and visibility in both AI and traditional search engines. From tracking visibility in LLMs to real-time monitoring of technical site health and scaled AI content creation, Conductor provides a single source of truth that fuels digital growth—all from one platform.


Conductor is a mission-driven company with a commitment to innovation, customer success, and culture. For Conductor, success is improving the lives of everyone in our orbit—our customers, our customers' customers, our employee-owners, and our communities.


Conductor is seeking a Principal Platform Engineer to be a builder, systems thinker and a technical leader. You will evolve our hybrid cloud and bare-metal platform, enabling product and engineering to deliver software faster and more reliably. We run terabyte-scale Elasticsearch clusters, a high-volume CI/CD pipeline ecosystem, and production workloads across thousands of containers, with a strong focus on automation, observability, and resilience. You are an excellent communicator and collaborator, able to align multiple teams and influence technical direction. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will shape platform roadmap and best practices across teams, influencing how engineers design, deploy, and operate critical services that power multiple products and business domains.


What you'll do (Responsibilities):

  • Define the platform vision and deliver incrementally: Shape and execute platform initiatives across hybrid cloud and bare-metal environments in small, value-driven steps that improve usability and adoption. Establish pragmatic standards for infrastructure, security, and operations, balancing consistency with flexibility. 
  • Lead critical platform initiatives: Take ownership of high-impact platform projects, driving them end-to-end from design through implementation.
  • Level up platform engineering  : Mentor and elevate platform engineers to grow their skills, raise the technical bar, and foster a culture of excellence in the team.
  • Drive technical decisions and standards: Influence design decisions and promote engineering best practices to build robust, scalable, and maintainable systems.
  • Enable self-service platform capabilities: Build and enhance self-service platform features and workflows to improve developer experience and standardized workflows across traditional, AI, and agentic use cases.
  • Accelerate Continuous Delivery: Streamline CI/CD to enable fast, reliable, and low-friction software delivery, minimizing manual toil and boosting developer velocity.
  • Lead Reliability and Observability Initiatives: Drive reliability and observability initiatives, leading postmortems and implementing SLOs, monitoring, and resilience patterns to strengthen platform stability.


Who you are (Required Skills/Abilities):

  • 16–20+ years of overall experience in platform, cloud, or infrastructure engineering, including hybrid cloud and bare-metal environments.
  • Hands-on experience in platform engineering environments, applying first-principles thinking, elevating team output and driving value.
  • Proven experience in both small startups and large, fast-moving enterprises, adapting quickly to diverse organizational dynamics.
  • Track record of applying a product mindset to platform engineering, understanding internal users, and solving systemic issues to enhance productivity and adoption.
  • Strong background in CI/CD, automation, container orchestration, and infrastructure tooling (Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, Terraform).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage production systems end-to-end, combining operational ownership with technical guidance.
  • Applies enterprise-grade security and compliance practices while enabling innovation, ensuring the platform remains secure
  • Experience in operating high-scale distributed applications, with expertise in database technologies (SQL, NoSQL), Elasticsearch, caching layers, and large-scale data pipelines.


Compensation: Conductor maintains competitive, performance-based compensation programs. The Berlin base salary range for this role is currently 130,000 - 160,000 euro.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Conductor LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Bringing in diverse perspectives and challenging our assumptions is the clear key to growth; it drives innovation, creativity, faster problem-solving, and stronger decision making. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, train, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. 


Conductor does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, or other characteristics protected by state or federal law or local ordinance.  In addition, it is the policy of Conductor to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works.

verdane-instabee:teamtailor:39d7d955-b02.title: Implementation Lead
verdane-instabee:teamtailor:39d7d955-b02.descriptionHtml:
About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 through the merger of two fast-growing last-mile delivery companies: Budbee and Instabox. Together, we’re building a new standard for e-commerce logistics — one that’s faster, more flexible, and tailored to the needs of merchants and consumers alike. Instabee delivers millions of parcels each month across Europe. We work with thousands of e-commerce merchants and are rapidly becoming Europe’s leading delivery and logistics partner.

In the Netherlands, Budbee operates a rapidly growing network of smart parcel lockers, providing fast, convenient, and sustainable delivery solutions. We proudly partner with major retailers such as Albert Heijn, Bol.com, and H&M to make package pickup easier and more accessible for consumers across the country.

About the Role

Instabee is looking for a commercially-driven, tech-savvy, and hands-on Implementation Manager to join our Integration & Tech Sales team in Amsterdam. This is a role where technical expertise meets commercial impact — and where your work directly shapes how merchants experience Instabee from day one.

You will play a key role in enabling and continuously improving our merchant offerings via API integrations, ensuring a smooth and fast go-to-market experience. By collaborating closely with commercial, product, tech, and operations teams, you'll drive integrations that make it simple and efficient for merchants to launch Instabee's services for their customers.

In the highly competitive delivery space, speed and quality matter. As an Implementation Manager, you'll be the driving force behind getting merchants live faster — while making sure Instabee's solutions deliver real value from the very start.


What You'll Do

  • Drive the technical value proposition in complex deal cycles, aligning integration roadmaps with business objectives to remove friction and accelerate merchant launches.

  • Take full ownership of onboarding and integrations for new merchants, ensuring an excellent and seamless launch experience.

  • Partner with commercial teams to accelerate go-to-market timelines, ensuring merchants can quickly leverage Instabee's solutions.

  • Work cross-functionally with tech, product, and operations to simplify complex integrations and solve challenges in real time.

  • Monitor integration and performance data to identify improvement areas and proactively strengthen our processes.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with merchants that go well beyond launch — acting as a trusted long-term partner.

About You

You thrive where commercial strategy meets technical delivery. You're structured, proactive, and solution-oriented — but also curious and adaptable enough to navigate complexity with confidence. You know how to translate technical concepts into business value, and you take pride in turning complex integrations into smooth, successful launches.

More About You

  • University degree in business, engineering, or a related field.

  • 3–5 years of experience in e-commerce or logistics, preferably in implementation, technical account management, or commercial excellence.

  • Understanding of API integrations — hands-on experience with Postman or similar tools is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and Dutch; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

  • Commercial mindset with a proven ability to shorten time-to-market and improve onboarding processes.

  • Based in Amsterdam, with flexibility to travel internationally when required (office-first position).

What We Offer

🎂 26 vacation days per year + your birthday off (based on full-time)

🏢 Modern office in Amsterdam Noord — at The Collection, with in-house gym

🏦 8% employer-paid pension (no personal contribution needed)

🎉 Team events, social outings, and a friendly work culture

🚆 Travel reimbursement if you live outside Amsterdam

🧘 Well-being allowance (€25 per month)

🥗 Daily lunch allowance

💻📱 High-end equipment provided

💰The gross monthly salary for this position ranges from 5000 € depending on experience.

🚀 Interested? Let’s Hear From You!

Even if you don’t tick every box, we still encourage you to apply. At Budbee Netherlands, we believe great people don’t always fit a job description perfectly — and that’s okay.
We’re looking for people who want to make an impact. If you’re curious, driven, and excited to grow, we’re excited to meet you. Most of what we learn happens on the job, and we’re more than happy to teach you along the way.
What matters most to us is your motivation. So tell us why you’d love to join Budbee Netherlands and what you’re excited to bring to the team!

yc-zip:ashbyhq:d250ca47-4ed5-449c-8006-6.descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 5+ year of closing experience in technology SaaS sales at enterprise level

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

  • You’d describe yourself as organized, efficient with your time, and excellent communicator

  • Experience using tools like Salesforce, Zoominfo, LinkedIn SalesNav, and Outreach

  • Willing to go the extra mile to make sure our customers, company, team, and yourself succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree is required (specifically in Finance, Technology, or a related field or experiential equivalent)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal 

The salary range for this role is $250,000 - $315,000 OTE. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners for SF employees

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

  • 💸 401k plan

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
